items.title: Ava DuVernay Defends Using AI in New Doc '14th'
items.excerpt: DuVernay explains her decision to use AI to bring public-domain archival photographs to life in her Netflix documentary 14th, saying audiences should make their own decisions about how they feel about the technology.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere
items.excerpt: Apple's November Creator Studio update builds MotionVFX content into Final Cut Pro and adds text-to-image generation and editing tools to Final Cut Pro and Pixelmator Pro, plus an AI assistant across its productivity apps.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve is Getting Faster as Latest Update Boosts IntelliSearch and OGraf Playback
items.excerpt: Blackmagic's DaVinci Resolve 21.1.2 promises up to 14x faster AI-driven IntelliSearch media analysis on Apple M6, along with improved timeline editing and faster OGraf playback.

items.title: Blackmagic Discounts Resolve Studio as AI Performance Improves
items.excerpt: Blackmagic cuts Resolve Studio 20% and reports its AI tools run much faster on Apple M6 and Nvidia RTX Spark: AI Super Scale nearly 70% faster HD-to-8K and AI Speed Warp over 60% faster than on M5.

items.title: Google's next Genie AI model generates more realistic experiences
items.excerpt: Google announced Genie 4, a world model that generates more realistic interactive AI environments, coming soon to Google AI Ultra subscribers via a Project Genie waitlist.

items.title: I tried the ArtCraft video editor, FilmCraft, so you don't have to
items.excerpt: Scott Simmons tests FilmCraft, ArtCraft's vibe-coded Premiere Pro clone whose code was largely written by AI, and assesses whether AI-built editing software is usable for real post work.

items.title: Maxon Fall 2026 release gives you more creative control
items.excerpt: Maxon's 2027.0 release adds Scene Light, an AI-powered depth-aware relighting tool for live-action footage in After Effects, and an MCP server that opens Autograph to agentic AI workflows.

items.title: SNTPCT Calls for 2-Hour Walkout of French Animation and VFX Workers
items.excerpt: France's majority animation union calls a Nov. 18 walkout pressing producers on pay and a generative AI amendment barring employers from compelling workers to use or develop GenAI tools.

items.title: Tokyo: TIFFCOM Market Chief On Riding the Japanese IP Wave as Entertainment Landscape Shifts Due to AI
items.excerpt: TIFFCOM managing director Kaori Ikeda discusses adapting Japanese IP as short dramas rise, streamers cut budgets and AI disrupts production, with AI added as a market keynote this year.

items.title: AI Joke Theft Leaves Comedians Feeling Violated
items.excerpt: Comics Olga Namer, Olivia Carter and Natalie Cuomo describe seeing their material repackaged by AI-generated avatar women, sometimes for millions of views.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View Conference, directors of 'GOAT,' 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed the box office, original storytelling and, unavoidably, generative AI's place in animation.

items.title: Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
items.excerpt: BBC's Blue Planet III is keeping shots that would normally hit the cutting room floor to prove its footage is real as AI-generated nature video spreads.

items.title: AI Agent vs Human on Sound Design
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge pits an AI sound-design agent against a human sound designer on the same AI film clip.

items.title: This AI trick Magically Creates New Camera Angles
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge demonstrates an AI technique for generating new camera angles from existing footage for AI filmmaking.

items.title: The new rules of safety in an era of real-time video generation | Runway AI Summit SF 2026
items.excerpt: Runway's Eliza Jacobs and Conner McDowell discuss safety and moderation approaches for real-time AI video generation at Runway AI Summit SF 2026.
